documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited held its earnings conference call for H2 FY26 and FY26 on June 3, 2026, reporting strong consolidated financial performance with significant increases in income, EBITDA, and PAT. Management discussed fleet expansion activities including the acquisition of offshore support vessels like Artemis and plans for further additions. The company remains optimistic about the offshore and maritime sectors, supported by favorable government initiatives and industry demand-supply dynamics. Operational strategies continue to focus on disciplined fleet expansion, effective cost management, and improving utilization levels. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of Rs 322.64 crore and net profit of Rs 80.80 crore for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a turnover increase of 10% from current levels assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for oil drilling and production programs requires vessels, and demand is expected to remain strong.
demand_outlook.quote: One war has, you know, the thought process has changed. As you know that Iran war has really caused a huge kind of problem for our government. So, looking at that, we feel that the demand for all these kind of any oil drilling program or production program, you need vessels. And that is where we come in. So, we hope that the demand will be always there quite strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Offshore investments are noted to be rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into the owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent a total of about $15 million for both new vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis for FY26, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a growth of 75.05% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,763 basis points to 47.28% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04% for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: A five-year contract has already been signed with Hardy Oil for the vessel Hades.
orders_capacity.quote: We have already got a charter with Hardy Oil for a five-year contract and...

orders_capacity.claim: Out of eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have recently come out of charter, and one is newly acquired.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The network includes 12 major and 200+ minor ports along a 7,516.6 km coastline.
orders_capacity.quote: Network includes 12 major and 200+ minor ports along a 7,516.6 km coastline

capital_allocation.claim: The difference between corporate tax and tonnage tax is mandated to be used for purchasing another vessel within 10 years.
capital_allocation.quote: So, this what we do is whatever is, you know, between the corporate tax and the tonnage tax is used as for purchasing of another vessel. And that is mandatory, within 10 years you have to do so much purchase.

management_commitments.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated their commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
